notes: CIncendiaryGrenade is the one common weapon class the genesis set misses: DemoViewer.NET's SDK#34 verification found it as a real m_hLastWeapon target on demo data, while its sibling CMolotovGrenade and the other four grenades are all covered. Added with no fields of its own — under the SDK#30 prefix layout it is a marker class whose binding is its parent chain's layout verbatim (CMolotovGrenade -> CBaseCSGrenade -> CBasePlayerWeapon), so covering the class is the whole change. Server module only; the bare name is unambiguous, so no module pin.
